title: Insights
help: How the cluster grows and how busy it is, what it will need next month, and what to fix. The console samples every cluster every few minutes; forecasts are straight-line trends of that history, and CPU, memory and disk come from the cluster's Prometheus.
noSamplesYet: No samples yet - the first arrive a minute after the console starts
youngHistory: Forecasts get better as history builds up: the first trends appear after an hour of samples, and they become reliable after about a week (busy days and quiet days both included).
overviewError: Could not read the server's live statistics: {{error}}
noClusters: Your access policies don't allow Insights on any cluster of this project (it needs insights.view).
recommendationsHelp: Worked out from the samples, the live statistics and Prometheus. Each says why and what to do; SQL can be copied into the SQL editor.
storageHelp: Size of all databases together, with the 30-day forecast (dashed).
tpsChartHelp: Commits and rollbacks, with the trend of the daily busy hour.
connectionsHelp: Client connections, the limit, and where the busy hour is heading.
rowsHelp: Rows read by queries and rows written (inserted, updated, deleted).
nodesSource: From Prometheus at {{url}} (node_exporter). Disk is the filesystem that holds the PostgreSQL data directory.
needsPrometheusLong: CPU, memory and disk forecasts come from the cluster's Prometheus. Add a VM with the Monitoring role to the cluster, or set the Prometheus URL on the Observability page.
noNodeMetrics: Prometheus answered, but has no node_exporter metrics for this cluster's nodes.
nodesFootnote: Suggested vCPU keeps the busy hour (p95) near 65% with next month's trend; disk to have keeps 25% free at the 30-day forecast.
databasesHelp: Size and growth of each database.
tablesHelp: The 100 biggest tables of the database: dead rows and the space they waste (bloat), growth from the hourly samples, and how they are read.
queriesHelp: Statements by total execution time (pg_stat_statements, since its last reset).
noPgss: pg_stat_statements is not enabled on this cluster - see the recommendation above.
serverLine: PostgreSQL {{version}} · up since {{started}} · shared_buffers {{sb}} · work_mem {{wm}} · cache hit {{hit}} · oldest transaction ID age {{xid}}
